Questions and Answers

Why is First Academy the best place to take a free Sample Test? + −

Our free mock tests are fully evaluated. They are trusted as the benchmark by several large educational institutions all across the country

Our tests give a clear idea of the difficulty level of the test and an accurate assessment of you test scores. This is very important if you want to clear the IELTS in the first attempt.

Whether it is a computer based test or a paper based IELTS mock test, all the tests are curated and evaluated by a Cambridge certified trainer so you can be sure that the IELTS test results are accurate.

Free mock tests provided by First Academy are an invaluable resource for students looking to improve their academic performance and take their studies to the next level. Taking a free mock test from First Academy can help students gain an edge in competitive college admissions and scholarship processes, build their confidence in test-taking, and increase their chances of securing top scores on the real test.

Here are 5 Reasons why you should take a First Academy IELTS Mock Test

There are many compelling reasons to take a free mock test from First Academy. First and foremost, the test provides a realistic representation of the actual test that students will take. It allows them to familiarize themselves with the structure, timing, and types of questions they can expect to encounter on the actual test. Such a comprehensive trial run gives students the confidence and preparation necessary to excel on the real test.

Second, taking a free mock test from First Academy can help students to identify their strengths and weaknesses in test-taking. It allows them to identify areas where they need to sharpen their skills and understand the types of questions they will be asked on the actual test. This allows them to focus their study efforts and ensure that they are making the most of their study time.

Third, the free mock tests from First Academy provide students with an opportunity to practice their test-taking strategies in a safe and supportive environment. This helps them to develop a resilient attitude towards test-taking and ensures that they are well-equipped to face the pressure of the real test.

Fourth, taking a free mock test can also help students practice their time management skills. Students are able to familiarize themselves with the allotted time for each question and the overall time limit of the test. This allows them to budget their time efficiently and ensures that they are able to complete the real test within the allotted time.

Finally, taking a free mock test can also help students to increase their chances of scoring well on the actual test. The free mock tests from First Academy are designed to provide an accurate representation of the actual test. By familiarizing themselves with the test content and structure, students can apply the same strategies to answer questions on the real test and improve their chances of securing top scores.

In conclusion, taking a free mock test from First Academy is an incredibly valuable resource for students looking to improve their academic performance and take their studies to the next level. The test provides a realistic representation of the actual test, allows students to identify their strengths and weaknesses, practice their test-taking strategies, and hone their time management skills. Furthermore, it also helps them to increase their chances of scoring well on the actual test.

Will the First Academy test questions appear in the real exam? + −

The questions one encounters in a mock test are not necessarily the same questions that he/she will face in the real exam. This is because mock tests are designed to simulate actual exam conditions, not to replicate them. In this way, a mock test can be quite different from an actual exam.

The most obvious difference between mock tests and real exams is the nature of the questions. In a mock test, questions are designed to give a test-taker the opportunity to practice answering more difficult questions than he/she would see on an actual exam. This often includes extensive research and analysis, or questions that require the use of multiple resources. These questions are not meant to be an exact replica of the actual exam questions; instead, they are meant to give the test-taker a taste of what the exam might look like.

In addition to the type of questions, the length of a mock test (look at our mini-mock test here) can be quite different from an actual exam. Mock tests are often designed to measure a test-taker's ability to answer questions under a certain amount of time, whereas an actual exam will give the test-taker the full amount of time to answer each question. This means that the test-taker can take as much time as he/she needs to answer the questions on the actual exam, which may not be the same amount of time he/she is given on the mock test.

Finally, the difficulty level of the questions in a mock test (look at our full-length mock test here) can be quite different from the difficulty level of the questions in the actual exam. Mock tests are designed to give test-takers the opportunity to practice answering questions of various levels of difficulty, which might not match the actual exam. Mock tests are typically used to give test-takers a preview of what the exam will be like, so they can become familiar with the material and gain confidence in taking the test.

In summary, the questions one encounters in a mock test will not appear in the real exam due to differences in the types of questions, the length of the test, and the difficulty level of the questions. Mock tests are meant to simulate an actual exam, so you can be sure of getting the same question types, but not necessarily the same questions.

Can i retake the tests any number of times? + −

Yes, you can retake the IELTS test any number of times. However, each time you retake the test, you will have to pay the exam fee. To avoid this, we recommend you to take a free test or attend a free session. This will tell you if you are ready for the test.

If you feel you are ready for the test, you may contact us for help you register for the IELTS exam anywhere in India. If you are not sure, First Academy offers the best IELTS coaching anywhere in India. You can attend a free session of our coaching and interact with one of our trainers to see what kind of preparation you need.

All our sessions are interactive and take learners of all levels into account. Whether you are looking for Online IELTS coaching or Classroom Training, our faculty intimately knows the test and can help you with any question you might have.

Do I get a personal feedback from the trainer for writing or speaking evaluations? + −

Yes! Our IELTS training is the only training program that includes personal trainer feedback sessions! You will have the opportunity to not only interact with the trainer during the session, but we will be happy to set-up an individual meeting so you may have a detailed feedback from the trainer about where you have hit the mark and where you need to improve.

Our one-to-one sessions have been very highly and positively reviewed. They are designed to help you guarantee understanding of the task and also meaningfully improve you score. If you wish to set up a personalised session for Writing or Speaking section of the IELTS test, you only need to contact our counselloers, and they will do the rest!

These sessions are one of the many reasons why First Academy is considered to provide the best IELTS coaching. Attending a free session, or taking a look at our material will help you understand the depth of our understanding and the breadth of our knowledge about the test. The First Academy's IELTS Reading Big Book has been used by students in over 12 countries and hail it as one of the best IELTS Reading Materials on the planet.
